hr.time_entry.v1.ListTimeEntriesRequest.description:
ListTimeEntriesRequest selects logged time. Every filter is optional and
they combine with AND. The response is always a page: callers that need
everything must follow offset until total is reached.

date.description:
Filter by exact date; absent to include all dates. Ignored when from_date
or to_date is supplied.

employee_id.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.

from_date.description:
Include entries dated on or after this day (ISO-8601, e.g. "2026-04-01");
absent to leave the range open at the start.

is_billable.description:
Filter by billability; absent to include both billable and non-billable
time.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

project_id.description:
Filter by the Flow project the time was logged against; absent to include
all projects and entries with no project.

status.description:
Filter by workflow status (draft | submitted | approved | rejected);
absent to include all statuses.

to_date.description:
Include entries dated on or before this day; absent to leave the range
open at the end.

limit.description: Page size used for this request.

total.description: Total number of matching time entries across all pages.

employee_id.description: Filter by employee; absent to include all employees.

status.description: Filter by status; absent to include all statuses.

timesheets.description: Page of timesheets matching the filters.

hr.time_entry.v1.MarkTimeEntriesInvoiced.description: MarkTimeEntriesInvoicedBody is the payload of markTimeEntriesInvoiced.

entry_ids.description:
entry_ids are the time entries this invoice bills. Every entry must
belong to the caller's business; foreign or missing ids are counted as
skipped rather than failing the batch.

invoice_id.description: invoice_id is the finance invoice that settles them.

hr.time_entry.v1.MarkTimeEntriesInvoiced.description:
MarkTimeEntriesInvoicedRequest records that the listed approved billable
entries are settled by one finance invoice. Idempotent per entry: an entry
already carrying a billable_invoice_id is skipped, never overwritten.

body.description: body carries the batch fields bound from the HTTP payload.

id.description: ID kept for route symmetry with approveTimesheet; unused by the handler.

hr.time_entry.v1.MarkTimeEntriesInvoiced.description:
MarkTimeEntriesInvoicedResponse reports how the batch landed, so a caller
can tell "all marked" from "some were already invoiced" without a second
read.

marked_count.description: marked_count is how many entries now carry this invoice id.

skipped_count.description:
skipped_count is how many of entry_ids were already invoiced, not
approved billable work, or belong to another business.

timesheet_id.description: ID of the timesheet to submit for approval.

hr.time_entry.v1.TimeEntryPayload.description: TimeEntryPayload is a logged unit of employee work time.

approved_by.description: Employee ID of the approver; absent if not yet approved.

category_id.description: Time category for reporting; absent if uncategorised.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

date.description: Date the work was performed (ISO-8601 format, e.g. "2026-04-14").

description.description: Free-text description of the work performed.

duration_minutes.description: Total duration of work in minutes.

end_time.description: Clock-out time (ISO-8601 time or datetime); absent if duration-only entry.

id.description: Unique identifier for the time entry.

is_billable.description: Whether this time is billable to a client.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this entry belongs to.

project_id.description: Associated project; absent if not project-based.

rejection_reason.description: Reason the entry was rejected; absent unless status is rejected.

source.description: How the entry was created (manual | timer | flow_import).

start_time.description: Clock-in time (ISO-8601 time or datetime); absent if duration-only entry.

task_id.description: Associated task; absent if not task-level tracking.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

hr.time_entry.v1.TimesheetPayload.description: TimesheetPayload is an employee's time entries grouped over a period.

total_minutes.description: Sum of all entry durations in minutes.
